title: Illnesses limiting the ability to work among Bavarian-Swabian civil servants – Survey conducted by the Medical Examination Center of the Government of Swabia in 2024 and 2025
summary:
The aim of this study is to record the clinical pictures that had a relevant impact on the health and thus the incapacity to work of Bavarian-Swabian civil servants in the calendar years 2024 and 2025. The aim is to identify the main groups of illnesses (e.g., mental illness or joint disease) that most frequently lead to prolonged illness and extended periods of absence from work. 
To this end, the data of all Bavarian-Swabian civil servants who were examined at the medical examination center of the Government of Swabia in the calendar years 2024 and 2025 will be evaluated retrospectively for these main groups of illnesses.
conditions: Mental and behavioral disorders, diseases of the nervous system, diseases of the musculoskeletal system and connective tissue, as well as external causes of morbidity and mortality, neoplasms, diseases of the circulatory system, diseases of the blood and blood-forming organs, endocrine/ nutritional and metabolic diseases, diseases of the respiratory system, diseases of the digestive system, diseases of the urogenital system, diseases of the eye and adnexa, diseases of the ear and mastoid process, diseases of the skin and subcutaneous tissue

interventions.name: The plan is to conduct a comprehensive survey of all Bavarian-Swabian civil servants employed on a permanent or probationary basis who underwent a medical examination by a public health officer at the medical examination center of the Government of Swabia between January 1, 2024, and December 31, 20

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
All Bavarian-Swabian civil servants employed on a permanent or probationary basis who underwent a medical examination by a public health officer at the medical examination center of the Government of Swabia between January 1, 2024, and December 31, 2025, to assess their fitness for duty or reactivation.
Exclusion criteria:
Exclusion criteria were the lack of formal (e.g., residence outside Bavarian Swabia) or substantive (e.g., duration of illness less than three months) jurisdiction of the medical examination center of the government of Swabia.
